_comment: Finishing times for classics race-years where PCS publishes no Time column,
sourced from bikeraceinfo.com. Applied by patch_classics_times.py, which
`gap` is verbatim from the source: 's.t.' means same time as the rider above
(bikeraceinfo's equivalent of PCS's ditto), and the patch script resolves the
chain. Rank 1 carries `winner_time` instead; every other row is a gap to the
winner, never an absolute time — see ai-context.md rule 2.
Names are as bikeraceinfo prints them (Firstname Lastname); the patch script
matches them against PCS's 'Lastname Firstname' by normalized token set and
REFUSES to write unless every rank matches.
_overrides_comment: Winner times that PCS has WRONG, not merely missing, replaced from
bikeraceinfo. patch_classics_times.py normally refuses to touch a row that
already has a time; an entry here is an explicit, reviewed exception.
Only add one when a second source and an arithmetic check agree.

1915.why: PCS serves '3:18' for this edition, which parses to 198 seconds and yields 5254 km/h over 289 km; read as 3h18m it still gives 88 km/h. bikeraceinfo has 'Ezio Corlaita (Dei) 10hr 36min 3sec. 27.26 km/hr', and 289 / 10.6008 = 27.26 reproduces their published speed exactly, confirming both the time and our stored distance.

2005._aliases_comment: rank -> the PCS spelling, where the two sources write the same rider differently. Reviewed one at a time on purpose: a fuzzy matcher would have swallowed the rank-33 conflict below.
2005._disputed_comment: rank -> why it is NOT filled. Genuine source disagreement, not a spelling variant. Empty here: the one conflict was resolved, see `corrections`.
2005._corrections_comment: Where this file departs from bikeraceinfo because a third source settled it. Recorded rather than silently edited, so the divergence stays auditable.

corrections.33: bikeraceinfo names this rider Bram Tankink; the results row below says Guido Trenti instead. PCS has Trenti 33rd and Tankink DNF, and cyclingflash.com/race/gent-wevelgem-2005/result independently shows '33 Guido Trenti Quick Step - Innergetic + 31' with no Tankink anywhere. Two sources against one, and the +31sec gap is identical in all of them, so only the name was wrong. Confirmed by Eric 2026-08-13.
